But first, I want to acknowledge that we're broadcasting here at FBI Radio on unceded Gadigal land and that this land was never ceded. And I pay my respects to all elders past, present and any listeners of First Nations descent listening today. The general idea of this show is to explore the liberatory effects of music, to look at how music is both colonised and reclaimed and used in decolonial ways, all while liberating the individual. And I think this interview with Tilo and this album as a whole, pages from my notebook, which has just dropped today, reflect that spirit in a lot of ways. I'm going to play a song off the album, Reminiscing and Premonitions, and then I'll jump straight into the interview and let him speak for himself. You're listening to FBI Radio 94.5.
